text:
Anya: Heads-up — I want to schedule a 45–60m "Latency & Cost Surgery" to triage the 3/2 regression on the small-batch path and review the new cost dashboard insights.
Anya: Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 15:00-16:00 PT. Which works? @phil @sam @mari @jordan
Phil: Thu 15:00 PT works for me. prefer shorter 45m if we can stick to agenda. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thu works. can we add a demo of the quantized variant perf? I have a short snippet to show.
Mari: Thu is ok. please add "canary fallout logs" as an agenda item — there's one error pattern I want us to check.
Jordan: Tue conflicts for me. Thu is safest. 45m+ focused agenda pls. Also can we get an infra readout on pending capacity that may affect throughput measurements?
Anya: Great — Thu 15:00 PT then. Draft agenda below, open to edits.
Anya: ```
Agenda (45m):
- 0-5m: quick status + goals for this readout
- 5-20m: latency distribution + tail analysis (small-batch path)
- 20-30m: cost dashboard highlights and token-unit regressions
- 30-38m: quantized variant demo + perf compare (Sam)
- 38-42m: canary fallout logs (Mari)
- 42-45m: action items + owners
```
Phil: Can we also add a short item to decide the metric to promote to SLO (p95 vs p99) — maybe 3m is enough.
Anya: added: metric decision at 5m mark (before deep dive).
infra-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/inference/latency-cost?range=24h — exported at 1768509800
Sam: link works. i'll prep the quantized-vs-fp16 table and upload a small CSV under the meeting thread.
Sam: quick note — if anyone needs the perf artifacts locally, run: 
```
scp perf-artifacts@artifacts:/s3/bench/1768509/*.tar.gz ./
```
Mari: re: canary logs — i'll post a 1-page summary in the thread by EOD. there are two buckets: OOM-ish and tokenization-timeouts.
Phil: who will own taking notes + action items? i'd volunteer if no one else.
Anya: Phil — thanks, pls take notes. i'll book the calendar and invite infra/eng-runtime leads.
Jordan: FYI: there's an open CR for the batcher that i'd like to get reviewed before the meeting — pinging @eng-runtime for a quick look. don't want the meeting to be blocked on an unmerged PR.
Phil: can you drop the PR link here? i'll skim and call out obvious blockers.
Jordan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/842 — main change is async queue drain on shutdown. test flakes could affect throughput numbers.
Anya: good call. jordan, please summarize any test-flake risks in 1-2 bullets before the readout.
Jordan: will do.
Sam: small request — can we precompute the per-model prefix cache hit matrix and attach it? that will help explain token divergence vs cost. i'll generate it by EOD.
Anya: perfect. final checklist:
- Phil: notes + action items
- Sam: quantized demo + prefix-cache matrix
- Mari: canary fallout summary
- Jordan: PR risk bullets
- Anya: calendar + invites + dashboards attached
Anya: if no objections, i'll lock the slot and post the meeting invite + pre-reads link in this thread in ~2h. :calendar:
Phil: no objections. :+1:
Mari: :+1:
Sam: thumbs up
infra-bot: Reminder — run the nightly infra snapshot 1h before meeting with `/infra snapshot --env prod --name readout-1768509`
Anya: thanks infra-bot, will trigger snapshot.
Anya: OK locking Thu 15:00 PT. Pre-reads will be here by EOD. See you all then.
